subtitle: Outdoor activity rain-conflict planning with human approval
description: Unpublished local build. Choose a city, enter one outdoor activity and a same-day availability window. City mode supports China / Asia/Shanghai only. Open-Meteo supplies city lookup and live weather. View deterministic candidates or ask the host-selected Agent; both share the same constraints, human approval and independent persisted read-back. No external calendar sync. City name goes to geocoding; coordinates go to weather; private activity context reaches the Provider only through the Agent path after host consent.
release_notes: Local Stage 1: confirmed cities, declared availability, explicit timezone limits, compatible activity records. Reuses the existing approval, journal and read-back core. Not a public release.
